title: Servex: follow(path) tells agents what changed

set.outcome:
**follow(path) is live: Servex watches a file or folder and sends each burst of changes to the agents that asked, as one message.**

- [x] follow / unfollow tools: live, `follow("public/")` refused
- [x] one watcher, many subscribers: 20 lines in 1 s arrived as 1 message, in order
- [x] only new lines, never a replay; a plain read sends nothing
- [x] survives a restart, ends when the agent stops: proof 15/15
- [x] docs checked by a fresh agent (6 gaps fixed); reviewed by hand: 5 bugs found, 5 fixed

Doc: [Servex/doc/follow.md](/Servex/doc/follow.md). Detail: [task.jsonl](task.jsonl), [review-fresh.md](review-fresh.md).

Left: Follow.js is 327 lines, not 150; a jsonl replaced by rename can resend lines (doc caveat).
